summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Network Capital premium onboarding flow refactor. All 6 screens tested (Auth → Welcome → The Shift → How It Works → Score+Rewards → Trust+Referral). Backend API tests: 8/8 passed. Frontend UI tests: All features working correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Emergent badge overlaps with Continue button (badge at y=798, button at y=788). Playwright force=True click sometimes doesn't work. JavaScript click works correctly.
ui_bugs.workaround: Use JavaScript click or progress dots for navigation

test_credentials.note: No pre-seeded accounts. Tests create new users dynamically.

seed_data_creation: None - tests create their own test data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Premium onboarding flow fully tested and working. Key features verified: 1) Screen 1 (Auth): Dark theme, Sign Up/Login toggle, Full Name field, Phone-first input with +27 country code, Email alternative toggle, Password field, Referral code field with gold border, Terms checkbox, Gold 'Create Account' button, Google/Apple social login placeholders. 2) Signup flow creates account with phone, full_name, referred_by_code stored in DB. 3) After signup, user proceeds to Screen 2 (Welcome) not immediately into app. 4) Screen 2 (Welcome): 'Your Network Has Value' title, app preview section. 5) Screen 3 (The Shift): 'Make Your Time Count' title, mini feed previews with mock posts showing earnings. 6) Screen 4 (How It Works): 4 steps (Connect, Engage, Build, Unlock) with descriptions. 7) Screen 5 (Score+Rewards): Merged screen showing Network Score display and reward tiers (3%, 7%, 10%). 8) Screen 6 (Trust+Referral): Trust badges, user's referral code display, WhatsApp share button (opens wa.me with pre-filled message), Enter App button. 9) Referral system awards $10 bonus to referrer when new user signs up with code. 10) Progress dots for navigation between screens. 11) Gold Continue buttons throughout. 12) Skip button available on non-auth screens.
